expected.equations: TAW = AWC × effective root depth. Initial depletion = TAW − initial storage. Adjusted p = clamp(0.1, 0.8, pTable + 0.04 × (5 − ETc)). Ks = (TAW − depletion)/(TAW − pAdjusted × TAW) when depletion exceeds readily available water. Actual transpiration = min(storage after inflows, ETc × Ks). Water residual = storage start + inflows − runoff − drainage − actual transpiration − storage end.

stepDayAndRunAssertions.route: One-cell standard open-field crop-model-v2 stepDay/simulateRun path; no environment-v2 snapshot.
stepDayAndRunAssertions.callThroughObserver: Observe exactly one actual stepFao56RootZone invocation during stepDay and invoke the original reducer unchanged. Assert initial state waterMm=1; AWC=1.0 mm/cm; effectiveRootDepthCm=5; depletionFraction is within the registered dimensionless arithmetic bound of 0.36; zero precipitation, irrigation, runoff, and root-growth storage; capillaryRiseMm omitted/undefined and defaulted to 0; potentialTranspirationMm=6. Restore the observer in finally before simulateRun.
stepDayAndRunAssertions.integratedStep: createRun must begin with rootZoneWaterMm=1 and capacity=5 mm. Assert effective environment ETo=5 mm, one-day unrounded dayStats.waterUseMm=1 mm, final cell rootZoneWaterMm=0 mm, nonnegative storage, and defined zero cell residuals. The captured Ks-adjusted potential demand is 1.875 mm, greater than the available 1 mm; actual uptake is capped at 1 mm.
stepDayAndRunAssertions.simulateRunAndReplay: One simulated day; summary waterUseMm=1; final storage and defined root-zone residuals match stepDay. A second simulateRun from the same frozen config and environment series must exactly match events, final state, and summary. No harvest event is expected.
